columns.name: usuario_atual
columns.server_default: CASE WHEN atual = 1 THEN usuario_id ELSE NULL END

constraints: (operacao = 'gerar' AND plano_anterior_id IS NULL) OR (operacao = 'recalcular' AND plano_anterior_id IS NOT NULL)
(estado = 'pendente' AND concluido_em IS NULL) OR (estado = 'concluido' AND concluido_em IS NOT NULL)

(estado = 'em_andamento' AND resposta_escolhida IS NULL AND correta IS NULL AND respondida_em IS NULL) OR (estado = 'respondida' AND resposta_escolhida IS NOT NULL AND resposta_escolhida IN ('A','B','C','D','E') AND correta IS NOT NULL AND correta IN (0,1) AND respondida_em IS NOT NULL AND respondida_em >= iniciada_em)
alternativa IS NULL OR alternativa IN ('A','B','C','D','E')
correta IS NULL OR correta IN (0,1)

columns.name: em_andamento_marcador
columns.server_default: CASE WHEN estado = 'em_andamento' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END

constraints: (estado = 'em_andamento' AND finalizada_em IS NULL AND total IS NULL AND respondidas IS NULL AND acertos IS NULL AND erros IS NULL AND em_branco IS NULL AND percentual_acerto IS NULL) OR (estado = 'finalizada' AND finalizada_em IS NOT NULL AND finalizada_em >= iniciada_em AND total IS NOT NULL AND total BETWEEN 1 AND 180 AND respondidas IS NOT NULL AND acertos IS NOT NULL AND erros IS NOT NULL AND em_branco IS NOT NULL AND percentual_acerto IS NOT NULL AND acertos >= 0 AND erros >= 0 AND em_branco >= 0 AND total = acertos + erros + em_branco AND respondidas = acertos + erros AND percentual_acerto = ROUND(100 * acertos / total, 2))
